name: static-mesh-gradient
summary: Full-bleed hero running Paper Shaders' static mesh gradient on WebGL2: amber, violet and blush folded into one smooth still field. The only background here that does not animate, which is upstream's own preset and not a restriction.

colors.description: Up to seven colour points. Omit to read --fx-c1 through --fx-c4 off the section, which is what keeps the shader and the CSS resting state on one palette. Upstream default preset.

speed.description: Upstream ships 0, so the section paints once and holds. Raise it to let the mesh drift; prefers-reduced-motion pins it back to 0.

positions.description: Which layout the colour points start from before the waves displace them.

mixing.description: How far the points bleed into one another. Low leaves visible seams between them, high is one continuous field.
